messages:
elaine: Hey team — during a live investor demo 20 mins ago our integration started getting a ton of 429s and occasional 401s. We're on the free tier, using api key proj-xyz in us-west. Demo's on staging but hitting production endpoints. We need a temporary burst or guidance fast. Repro: hitting /v1/generate with 1 request/sec per session, 15 sessions. Logs attached below.

maria (Support): Sorry about that, @elaine. Can you paste the exact request header (no bearer token) and the project id? Also: any recent key rotations?

elaine: Project: proj-xyz. Headers:
``` 
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer [REDACTED]
Content-Type: application/json
x-project-id: proj-xyz
```
No key rotations. We did share the key with an external demo tool earlier.

maria (Support): Thanks. Where are the 401s happening? Do you see "invalid_api_key" or "expired_token" in body?

elaine: Body shows:
```
{"error":{"type":"auth_error","message":"invalid_api_key"}}
```
Most are 429s with "rate_limit_exceeded". Last 60s spike ~600 reqs.

support-bot: Ticket #SR-2026 created and assigned to maria. SLA: 4 hours.

jake (SRE): @maria can you dump the quota counters for proj-xyz? I can also pull ingestion rate and IPs.

maria (Support): Pulling now. Looks like free tier cap is 60 requests/min for proj-xyz. Recent spike shows 620 reqs in last minute. IPs cluster: 52.12.33.21 and 18.204.45.99. Sounds like the external demo tool hammered it.

maria (Support): @ara (Sales) tagging — customer requests temporary burst for a 2-hour investor demo. Can we grant transient increase or a trial credit?

ara (Sales): We can issue a short-term boost for verified demos. Need customer billing contact and acceptance to temporary upgrade T&C. ETA 15m.

elaine: Billing contact is billing@acme-demo.com. They approve upgrade for 2 hours.

jake (SRE): Two parallel actions I'd suggest:
1) Rotate the API key (we'll issue a new one scoped to "staging-demo" so it doesn't affect production secrets).
2) Temporarily raise rate_limit to 500 r/min for proj-xyz for 2 hours.

maria (Support): Can you confirm you'll rotate the key? Customer agrees.

elaine: Yes please rotate. We can update the demo tool in 10m.

maria (Support): Executing rotation and requesting short-term quota bump. Running command:
```
/admin keys rotate --project proj-xyz --scope staging-demo
```
Response:
```
new_key: sk-temp-ABCD1234
expires_at: 2026-03-17T13:45:00Z
```

maria (Support): Quota change request sent to ops-oncall.

ops-oncall: Granting temporary rate_limit increase to 500 r/min for proj-xyz for 2 hours. Applied. Monitoring.

support-bot: Ops change logged: CHG-78921. Notifying SRE channel.

jake (SRE): Monitoring metrics — error rate drops from 18% to 0.5% after key rotation and bump. Latency stable. Good signal.

elaine: Confirmed demo completed successfully. Thanks! One follow-up: can you explain the free tier limits and steps to prevent this? We want to avoid accidental leaks.

maria (Support): Free tier guidance:
- Default rate limit: 60 req/min per project.
- Short-term bursts are considered on a case-by-case basis; sales-assisted for >2 hours.
Prevention tips:
- Use scoped API keys for demos and rotate frequently.
- Implement client-side backpressure and exponential backoff on 429s.
- Use server-side proxy that enforces per-client throttling.

maria (Support): Sharing a minimal retry header example:
```
X-Retry-After: 30
```
and client pseudo:
```
if (resp.status === 429) await sleep(random(500,1500));
```

ara (Sales): I'll follow up with a 1-month free trial offer for their account if they plan more demos. Sending formal approval to billing@acme-demo.com.

billing: Received. I'll provision a 48h trial credit and send invoice waiver. Please confirm customer email.

elaine: Confirmed billing@acme-demo.com. Thanks everyone.

maria (Support): Closing SR-2026 as resolved. Please reopen if anything else.

support-bot: SR-2026 status: resolved. Reaction :white_check_mark: from team.
